assertion_audit.failure_condition: Changing the refusal back to an EXIT-only diagnostic or admitting a red log with no failing id would fail the message or exit/pointer assertions.
Restoring the former expectation that missing logs must refuse despite a reasoned waiver contradicts production promotion_checks.py:2680-2683; implementing that refusal would fail exit_code == 0.
Returning matched or exempt instead of waived would fail the ledger verdict assertion.

Dropping or changing the reason or declaration during ledger persistence would fail the comparisons to independently retained fixture constants; these read persisted output rather than comparing a variable to itself.
Claiming a run-directory or measured log supplied the absent control would fail control_log_source == none.
Inventing a log citation or resolved path when none was named would fail the empty-log and absent-key assertions.

Discarding the cited path when the file is deleted or resolving it to the wrong directory would fail ledger path assertions; the expected path comes from the separately prepared fixture, not the returned record.
Leaving a successfully promoted live pointer behind would fail the filesystem existence assertion.
